actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.edit_image.description: Edit an image with Photoroom AI: background removal or generation, shadows, relighting, text removal, upscaling, expand and more in one call
actions.edit_image.props.backgroundColor: Solid background color. Hex code without the hash sign (for example FF0000) or HTML color name (for example red).
actions.edit_image.props.backgroundImage: Image to place behind the subject. Cannot be combined with Background Prompt.
actions.edit_image.props.backgroundPromp: Describe the AI background to generate, for example "on a marble table next to a window". Cannot be combined with Background Image.
Seed for the AI background generation; reuse a seed from a previous call to get a similar-looking background for the same prompt.
actions.edit_image.props.beautifyMode.de: Enhance the aesthetics of a product, food or car image. Works best with Remove Background enabled.
actions.edit_image.props.expandMode.desc: Fill transparent areas created by the output size based on the background content.
actions.edit_image.props.exportDpi.descr: Pixel density of the result image, between 72 and 1200 dpi.
actions.edit_image.props.exportFormat.de: Format of the result image. Defaults to PNG.
actions.edit_image.props.filename.descri: Name of the output file, including its extension (for example result.png).
actions.edit_image.props.lightingMode.de: Adjust the lighting of the image with AI.
actions.edit_image.props.margin.descript: Margin around the subject, as a ratio (0 to 0.49), percentage (for example 30%) or pixel value (for example 100px).
actions.edit_image.props.outputSize.desc: Size of the result: auto, originalImage, croppedSubject, or a custom size like 1600x1600.
actions.edit_image.props.padding.descrip: Padding around the subject, as a ratio (0 to 0.49), percentage (for example 30%) or pixel value (for example 100px). Ignored on cropped sides of the subject.
actions.edit_image.props.removeBackgroun: Remove the original background before applying the other edits. The API enables this by default.
actions.edit_image.props.shadowMode.desc: Generate an AI shadow under the subject.
actions.edit_image.props.textRemovalMode: Remove text found in the image with AI.
actions.edit_image.props.uncropMode.desc: Reconstruct cropped parts of the subject with AI.
actions.edit_image.props.upscaleMode.des: Upscale the image up to 4 times its original size. Fast is optimized for speed, Slow for quality.
actions.generate_image.description: Generate a new image from a text prompt with Photoroom AI
actions.generate_image.props.exportForma: Format of the result image. Defaults to PNG.
actions.generate_image.props.filename.de: Name of the output file, including its extension (for example result.png).
actions.generate_image.props.seed.descri: Seed for the image generation; reuse a seed from a previous call to get a similar-looking result for the same prompt.
actions.generate_image.props.size.descri: Aspect ratio and resolution of the generated image.
actions.get_account_details.description: Retrieve the Photoroom API plan and the remaining image credits
actions.removeBackground.description: Remove the background of the image given as input
actions.removeBackground.props.bgColor.d: Fill the background with this color instead of keeping it transparent. Hex code (for example FF0000) or HTML color name (for example red).
Return the full color image (RGBA) or only the alpha mask of the cutout.
actions.removeBackground.props.crop.desc: Crop the result to the bounding box of the subject.
actions.removeBackground.props.despill.d: Remove colored reflections left on the subject by a green screen background.
Name of the output file, including its extension (for example result.png).
actions.removeBackground.props.format.de: Format of the result image. Defaults to PNG.
actions.removeBackground.props.size.desc: Maximum size of the result image. Defaults to full.
auth.description: Create an API key in the [Photoroom API dashboard](https://app.photoroom.com/api-dashboard). Prefix the key with `sandbox_` to make free, watermarked test calls.
description: AI photo editing: remove backgrounds, generate AI backgrounds, create images from prompts and retouch product photos
